decision: Build a self-contained minimalist European roulette frontend in programming/modern-roulette
rationale: Brief from Oleg Bobokhidze: portfolio-grade, calm luxury UI, decoupled engine, dual-motion wheel/ball, provider inspector, full AI traceability
tradeoffs: Single-zero only; American 00 out of scope

decision: Single Vite+React+TS package with config -> engine -> renderer/audio -> ui layers enforced by ESLint (ADR-0001)
rationale: Engine testable in Node, renderer swappable behind WheelPort, only react/react-dom at runtime
tradeoffs: Lint rules rather than package boundaries enforce layering; audio added as a fifth folder

decision: Round machine BETTING->REQUESTING->SPINNING->RESULT with ERROR(RETRY|DISMISS) via whitelist table; illegal events logged, never thrown (ADR-0002)
rationale: Auditable transitions, trivially testable, double spins and late bets rejected by construction
tradeoffs: No queued spins: a second Space during a round is a no-op with a notice

decision: Two-phase motion: free run on SPIN (outcome unknown), then a Hermite landing plan in the wheel frame from the current state (ADR-0002)
rationale: Hides network latency, never jumps, always seats in the server pocket; settle rattle < half pocket so the resolved number cannot change
tradeoffs: Stylised rather than simulated physics; tuning constants live in MOTION

decision: Canvas 2D with bowl and rotor pre-painted to offscreen canvases (DPR<=2); about four draw calls a frame; clamped dt rAF loop
rationale: Holds about 60 fps without WebGL or a runtime dependency (58.5 fps measured mid-spin in GPU e2e)
tradeoffs: Repaints the cache on resize or font load; no per-pixel lighting

decision: Bet catalogue as data (157 spots incl. trios and first four) with one payout rule 36/coverage-1 pinned by a test (ADR-0003)
rationale: Preview, settlement, mock server and rules sheet read the same table and cannot drift; uniform 2.70% edge
tradeoffs: Variants such as La Partage need explicit new rules

decision: Cap a single chip to what fits (spot, round, balance) with a notice; Rebet and Double are all-or-nothing; clear and remove are undoable
rationale: Capping matches live tables; all-or-nothing keeps layout proportions; undoable clear prevents accidental loss
tradeoffs: Doubling near a limit must be done spot by spot

decision: OutcomeProvider returns discriminated unions; roundId is the idempotency key; TIMEOUT is retry-only and replays the committed round (ADR-0004)
rationale: Never charges twice and never shows an unconfirmed balance; stale responses ignored by roundId+state guard
tradeoffs: Real server must persist round ids; HttpProvider still to be written

decision: Winning number = numberFor(seed, roundId) via cyrb53+mulberry32 with rejection sampling; latency randomness is seeded too
rationale: Reproducible rounds for QA and tests; exact uniformity verified by a chi-square test over 37k rounds
tradeoffs: Demonstration-grade fairness only; not a certified RNG

decision: Hold the stake from REQUESTING and reveal the settled balance only when the renderer reports the ball has landed
rationale: The figure never spoils the result and matches the animation
tradeoffs: Hidden tabs (rAF paused) delay the reveal until the tab is visible

decision: One 14x5 grid; portrait is an exact quarter-turn; hotspots on shared edges/corners, larger on coarse pointers; tested geometry (ADR-0003)
rationale: A single source for both orientations; adjacency tests guarantee every hotspot sits on its numbers
tradeoffs: Inside hotspots are not keyboard tab stops (tabIndex -1)

decision: Hover/focus preview highlights covered cells and shows odds, coverage, chip return and limit in a fixed-height line
rationale: A wrapping preview line shifted the centred felt under the pointer and swallowed the first click (found by e2e); fixed height removes the layout shift
tradeoffs: Long previews are clipped on narrow phones

decision: Obsidian surfaces, bone ink, hairlines; champagne reserved for focus and wins; Instrument Serif display plus Inter with tabular-nums; even integer line heights; no glow or neon
rationale: Brief asks for refined, architectural minimalism; the e2e suite asserts line heights and tabular figures automatically
tradeoffs: Dark theme only; web fonts load from Google Fonts with system fallbacks

decision: Desktop: wheel left, table right; phone portrait: compact wheel beside readout, vertical table sized to remaining height, two-row dock; phone landscape: wheel sized by height, single-row dock
rationale: Every control stays in view without page scroll at 360x740, 390x844, 844x390, 820x1180, 1280x720 (e2e-checked)
tradeoffs: Secondary actions are icon-only below 1024px (labels kept for screen readers)

decision: Shared Sheet component: modal (centred, bottom sheet on phones) and non-modal drawer; right-aligned footer with primary last; Esc closes only the topmost sheet
rationale: Consistent dialogs; the rules modal over the inspector closed both before the open-stack fix
tradeoffs: Focus trap is lightweight (Tab cycling), not a full inert implementation

decision: Synthesised Web Audio (chip, launch, rim roll level, fret ticks, seat, win chimes) with persisted mute, lazily unlocked on first gesture
rationale: No asset files, nothing to fail to load; every call is a safe no-op when audio is unavailable

decision: Puppeteer e2e smoke (44 checks) with query-param determinism: force, seed, latency, landing, hold
rationale: Proves the full round, exact balance maths, error recovery, idempotent retry, typography rules and 5 layouts in a real browser
tradeoffs: Needs a local Chrome and a running dev server
